verdict.rationale: Wise documents providing 'global account details' for receiving payments (wise-docs-9), which supports viewing account/routing numbers, but there is no evidence of a dedicated bank verification letter generation feature. Additionally, community reports show account/routing numbers can change without warning (wise-comm-2, wise-comm-3, wise-comm-5), undercutting the 'anytime' reliability implied by the story. Missing for 10: documented bank verification letter/document generation tool, and confirmation that account numbers remain stable enough to be trusted 'anytime'.
